Radio propagation.question: The _____ was Behaviour of travelling radio waves.
Radio propagation.fact: Radio propagation is the behavior of radio waves as they travel, or are propagated, from one point to another in vacuum, or into various parts of the atmosphere. Since the Earth's atmosphere is not uniform in properties, calculation of the "line of sight" distance must include the refraction effect in the atmosphere, and attenuation at some frequencies due to precipitation and water vapor.
